sections.text: Introduction

The 7SS10 is a solid state bus bar relay manufactured by Siemens. This Bus Bar protection has the following features. High degree of stability even under influences owing to CT saturation.
Short tripping time in the event of an internal fault.

Correct behavior and proper response of relocation of faults. The measuring method which 7SS10 Bus Bar protection uses to detect a short circuit within the protection zone is Kirchoffs law.
This procedure details the steps required to completely check the proper operation and calibration of the 7SS10 relay. It is recommended this procedure be carried out on an annually bases. This work be carried out section of this document is divided into 3 sections.

The first preliminary steps to prepare for relay testing describes the activities required prior to testing. Some of these steps could be performed days before the actual test. The second section Preparation for testing describes the steps to set up the equipment for performing the actual tests. The third section is the actual test. The document is formatted the way to minimize the possibility of error causing personal injury or damage to equipment.

sections.text: Testing Procedure (s) Preparations
Obtain authorization form the control center.
Switch off the D.C
Withdraw out from the relay Type 7SS10 the fourth output tripping cards 7TJ11.

Isolate the relay 7SS10 from the current circuits by making short circuit between the input current terminals with the output current terminals for the relay on the terminal block for all feeders one by one.
After making the short circuit in step 4 open the slot between the input and output sides of the current terminal block to isolate the relay.
Switch on the DC
Measure the operating voltage on Bu1, Bu2 and the restraining voltage on Bu3, Bu4 on the fourth cards 7TD10. The reading must be zero volt.
After isolating the relay, install a short on the output terminals of the current circuit relay on terminal blocks for all feeders one by one.

Slowly increase the current until the supervision led (the bottom one from the three light emitted diodes on 7TS17 card) lights up.

sections.text: Testing Other Feeders
For all other feeders repeat the above test from step 1 to 9.
Trip Testing
Obtain permission from the Dispatching Center and perform a trip test on each feeder, one at a time.
Connect this feeder to the bus that you want to trip test.
Connect all other feeders to the other bus.
The bus coupler should be open to separate the two busses.
Switch off the DC.
Insert the special output tripping card 7TJ11 for this feeder.
Switch on the DC
Inject current to value equal to the tripping value or more until the circuit breaker trip.
Check that the circuit breaker trip.
Repeat the above step from step 1 to 9 for all feeders.
Repeat the above step from step 1 to 9 for all feeders.
